purpose: Teach: デイトレード/圏内/屈指/約款/朗報/物的/司書/仕掛ける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、デイトレード文化に流されなかった
lines.en: Your father—he never let himself be swept up in the daytrade mentality when we started out.
lines.style: Quiet reverence, looking backward. Slow, measured pace. Each phrase lands with weight. Voice settles on the memory like placing a hand on something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商圏内のお客様を一人一人覚えてらした
lines.en: That's right. Father knew his customers by name—every single one in our market.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Steady, clear delivery. Not boasting—bearing witness. Slight pause before 'every single one' to underscore the scope of his memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界屈指の経営者として尊敬された
lines.en: Your father was respected as one of the finest managers in the industry.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender observation. A little distance—speaking of someone who's gone, or at least gone from this moment. Trailing off slightly, letting the weight settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約約款を細部まで読まれた
lines.en: Yes. He read every contract clause, down to the smallest detail.
lines.style: Deliberate, clear affirmation. Slight emphasis on 'every' and 'smallest'—showing precision was a cornerstone. Measured, respectful tone. Not performing, remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員に朗報を伝える時は嬉しそうだった
lines.en: And when he had good news to share with the staff, you could see the joy in him.
lines.style: A small warmth enters the voice here. Still measured, but with a hint of a smile behind it. Slower on 'good news'—savoring the memory of his generosity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは物的証拠を重んじた判断をされた
lines.en: He was. He made his decisions based on facts, on evidence—never on feeling.
lines.style: Firm but not rigid. Steady affirmation. 'Facts' and 'evidence' get slight weight—these mattered to him. Closed off 'never on feeling' with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内図書室と司書を大事にされたぞ
lines.en: He placed real value on the company library and our librarian. That mattered to him.
lines.style: Slight surprise in the tone—highlighting something others might overlook. 'Mattered to him' comes with quiet insistence. A small, knowing smile beneath the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新規事業を仕掛ける勘所をお持ちでした
lines.en: He did. Your father had an instinct for knowing when and how to launch a new venture.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly broader than before. 'Instinct' is spoken with respect—acknowledging the ineffable. Closes with quiet dignity, like the end of a litany.
